text: Where it all started. Mark and Danny didn't set out to build a cafe, they built an RC digging pit because they loved the hobby and couldn't find anywhere in Merseyside that did it properly. Word got round, more people wanted a go, and what started as a bit of fun on the side turned into Digz N' Lidz. Everything since has been the two of them, building this place from the ground up.

The build has taken over most weekends for months. Sixteen seats around the pit, cafe tables for anyone who just wants food and a coffee, the till system, the booking system, all of it built piece by piece rather than bought off the shelf. Mark and Danny have put everything they've got into getting this right before opening day, down to the last detail.

We're opening our doors soon! Sixteen seats, three session lengths, and food and drink ordered straight to wherever you're sat. Updates land here as opening day gets closer, including how booking works and what's on the menu.

A lot of people ask if you can come just for food, the answer's yes. Eight cafe tables sit away from the digging pit for anyone who wants to eat and drink without booking a session, kids included. Order at the table, it comes straight to you, no faff.

First episode of the podcast is up. Mark and Danny talk through why they built Digz N' Lidz, what's gone into getting it ready, and what to expect when you visit. More episodes to come as we get closer to opening, catch it on the videos page or our YouTube channel.
